prompt: Asset type: High-fidelity mobile UI concept for the ezBookkeeping React Native application. Primary request: Design a polished Android sign-in screen for a personal bookkeeping app. Scene/backdrop: A realistic modern smartphone screen mockup, portrait orientation, soft neutral studio background, entire screen visible. Subject: A clean login screen with a small abstract teal bookkeeping mark, title ezBookkeeping, username or email input, password input with visibility icon, teal primary sign-in button, secondary registration link, forgot password link, and optional biometric sign-in icon. Style/medium: Production-ready mobile product design, calm financial app, Swiss-inspired, crisp typography, restrained rounded controls, subtle borders, accessible contrast. Composition/framing: Front-facing phone, portrait 9:19.5, generous vertical spacing, all controls aligned, no clipping or overlap. Color palette: White and cool gray surfaces, graphite text, teal-green primary accent, muted blue secondary accent, small coral only for errors. Text verbatim: "ezBookkeeping", "登录", "用户名或邮箱", "密码", "登录", "忘记密码？", "还没有账号？注册". Constraints: Chinese labels must be accurate and legible; show a usable app screen, not a marketing landing page. Avoid: English placeholder text, unreadable text, excessive gradients, glassmorphism, people, hands, fake logos, cropped phone edges.
